_about: Search snippets for copper, Argireline and PDRN rewritten 2026-09-22 to lead with the strongest verified proof point (docs/claims/); removes 'One of the most researched peptides' and 'Gentle'. Translations in the companion .translations.json (meta_description), registered by scripts/seo-translate.py.

copper-peptide-research.description: Copper peptide (GHK-Cu) is a peptide your body makes. Double-blind tested: 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than serum without it. Every study explained.

copper-peptide.description: 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu) serum, day gel-cream and night cream. Double-blind tested: 55.8% more wrinkle-volume reduction than the same serum without it.

acetyl-hexapeptide-8.description: Argireline® (acetyl hexapeptide-8) at 10%: in a double-blind trial, nearly 1 in 2 saw clearly smoother crow's feet in 4 weeks. On placebo, no one.

pdrn.description: PDRN skincare: 1% salmon PDRN serum and night cream. In a clinical study, PDRN softened crow's feet by up to 23% in 28 days, over twice as much as retinol.

copper-peptide-ghk-cu-renewal-serum.description: 2% copper peptide (GHK-Cu) serum with vitamin C and hyaluronic acid. In a double-blind trial, GHK-Cu cut wrinkle volume 55.8% more than the serum without it.

acetyl-hexapeptide-8-anti-wrinkle-serum.description: 10% Argireline® serum, the level used in the trials. Nearly 1 in 2 saw clearly smoother crow's feet in 4 weeks in a double-blind study. On placebo: no one.

pdrn-renewal-serum.description: 1% salmon PDRN serum. In a clinical study, PDRN softened the look of crow's feet by up to 23% in 28 days, more than twice as much as retinol.
